_about: The Meshy prompts for every model in VELSCOUR TACTICS. A full prompt is a subject line plus a style block. `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs <key>` prints one ready to paste; `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs` lists the keys. docs/MODELS.md explains the look and what each model is for.
look: Tactics-RPG job-class figures in the manner of the three Final Fantasy Tactics games, turned grim.

From the PlayStation game: compact figures about five heads tall, small plain faces with almost no nose, big gloves and boots, layered cloth over armour, muted earth and wine colours, each job readable from its hat and outline alone.
From the Game Boy Advance game: chunky, slightly oversized hands, feet and headgear, so a figure still reads when it is two centimetres tall on screen.
From the DS game: more costume detail per job (belts, pouches, trims, asymmetric pieces) and a distinct male and female cut of the same uniform.

Made VELSCOUR: the Grim Nocturne palette (grave steel, reliquary gold, wine, night indigo, undead flesh), worn, patched and travel-stained, lit as if by one lantern. Rarity shows in the craft of the costume, never in brightness.
Never: skull pauldrons, spikes on everything, glowing red eyes, faceless hoods, bat wings, neon, chains on everything. By the V and T rule, no letters or monograms anywhere.

style.character: Stylized hand-painted tactics-RPG character, compact 5-heads-tall proportions, small plain face with a tiny nose, oversized gloves and boots, layered worn cloth over armor, muted grimdark palette of grave steel, wine red, night indigo and tarnished gold, matte painted textures, no glow, no text or symbols. Full body, A-pose, arms 45 degrees down, legs slightly apart, empty hands, neutral expression, single character, plain background, game-ready low-poly.
style.monster: Stylized hand-painted tactics-RPG monster, chunky readable silhouette, oversized hands and feet, muted grimdark palette of undead flesh, grave steel, wine red and night indigo, matte painted textures, no glow, no text or symbols. Full body, A-pose, arms 45 degrees down, legs slightly apart, single figure, plain background, game-ready low-poly.
style.creature: Stylized hand-painted tactics-RPG creature, chunky readable silhouette, muted grimdark palette, matte painted textures, no glow, no text or symbols. Whole body, neutral standing pose, single creature, plain background, game-ready low-poly.
style.weapon: A single {subject}, stylized hand-painted tactics-RPG prop, chunky readable silhouette, worn grimdark materials, grave steel and dark wood with tarnished gold fittings, matte, no glow, no text. Isolated object, vertical, plain background, game-ready low-poly.
style.image: Character design sheet, front view, full body head to toe, standing in a relaxed A-pose with arms 45 degrees down and empty open hands, legs slightly apart, flat even lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no letters, no logo, no weapon.

negative: weapon in hand, text, letters, logo, skull shoulder pads, spikes, glowing eyes, realistic photo, long legs, tall thin proportions, base, pedestal, multiple characters

settings.pose: a-pose for the picture, t-pose or a-pose on the 3D step; bodies always have empty hands, weapons are separate models
settings.triangles: about 15-25k for heroes, 8-15k for monsters and townsfolk
settings.textures: 2k is plenty; the game copy is cut to 1024
settings.route: text to image first (so the design can be seen and checked for letters), then image to 3D, then rig

gender: Each class needs a male and a female body. Keep the uniform; give the female cut a shorter coat or tabard and the male cut broader shoulders. The subject lines below describe one of the two; swap 'man' and 'woman' for the other.

named.lisandra: An old witch three hundred years old, bent and sharp-eyed, long patched brown gown, crooked hat with no tassel, a lantern at her belt, good cheekbones
named.homunculus: An enormous, magnificent, beaming blacksmith in a leather apron over mismatched plate, huge forearms, a hammer loop, a great double-crescent axe strapped to his back
named.lily: A veiled sorceress in deep green and violet, floating rune charms on threads, crystal at the throat, face hidden below the eyes
named.jamie: A lean monk-jeweler with a hand drill on a cord and jeweler's lenses pushed up on his forehead, teal surcoat, many small pouches
named.stevie: A broad armoured woman with a dented helmet and a tower shield, sleeves rolled, armourer's apron over plate

classes.wizard: An elemental scholar, tall drooping pointed hat with a wide brim, rust-orange robe with gold hem singed black at the cuffs, ink-stained gloves, book chained at the belt
classes.necromancer: A courteous undertaker-mage, deep violet funeral coat with bone toggles, top-knot under a mourning hood, grave-dirt on the hem, a string of finger bones as a rosary
classes.barbarian: A muscular red-haired northern pit-fighter woman, horned fur cap, bare scarred arms, wolf pelt over one shoulder, wide studded belt, wrapped fists
classes.dragoon: A lancer who leaps, blue-grey scaled half-plate, tall swept-back wyrm-crest helm with a visor, long split tail-coat, heavy landing greaves
classes.totem_master: A spirit-pole shaman, carved wooden face-mask pushed up on the head, teal poncho with ochre bands, feather and bone talismans, bare feet wrapped in cord
classes.death_knight: A fallen champion, blackened plate rimed with frost, closed helm with a narrow slit, tattered wine cloak frozen stiff, pale blue frost tracing the edges of the plates, a plain unmarked breastplate with no emblem and no chest symbol
classes.arcane_sorcerer: A veiled star-gazer, night-indigo robe sewn with pale star studs, astrolabe on a chain, half-veil over the lower face, tall collar, brass lens on a headband
classes.carrion_witch: A swamp hag, crooked wide-brimmed black hat, moss-green ragged gown, crow feathers at the shoulders, a rag poppet doll tied to the belt, muddy hem
classes.bard: A roguish travelling minstrel, wine-red doublet with one sleeve slashed, feathered cap, half-cape, knife sheaths, fingerless gloves
classes.slime_lord: A king made of translucent cobalt slime in the shape of a stout man, small tarnished gold crown sinking into his head, a royal mantle floating inside the body
classes.boomerang_knight: A dashing light knight, teal surcoat over mail, rounded steel cap with a white plume, two curved-blade holsters crossed on the back, tall riding boots
classes.lancer: An unbreakable knight-captain, heavy pale-steel full plate, bucket helm with a flat crest, broad pauldrons, tower-shield bracket on the left arm, banner pole socket on the back
classes.dragon_knight: A wyrm-blooded knight, crimson scale armour with black trim, horned open helm, scaled gauntlets ending in claws, ember-orange lining to the cloak
classes.gunner: A powder-stained engineer, brass goggles on a leather cap, long oilskin coat, bandolier of charges, heavy tool belt, scorched gloves

armour._about: Append one of these to a class subject line. Meshy makes one fused mesh, so each armour look is the whole character generated again and rigged the same way. Start with tiers 1 and 3.
cloth: vigil robe with metal-thread trim and mantle
ancient vestment, heavy brocade, tarnished gold clasps
leather: hunter's long coat with reinforced shoulders
plate: rusted chain mail, dented pot helm
templar plate with engraved borders, tabard
ancient ornate plate, gold inlay, tall crest
